about: The p3 re-prove car-knowledge film v136-winter-digit (run r-pwr3re-0001, 2026-10-27, reverted in d9669be) replayed: the judge saw a lifted word the beat never showed (an empty frame), 5W-30 as the main picture of six shots and the same bars twice, a ShapeMatch ending on a bar before a quote card, a hook that is only a street word, and a woman as "me" in a man's voice. Its Film file is in "films" (the hero's sex is read from it).

pitches.logline: I check my own oil for the first time, the oil is black and a made-up neighbour mocks me for it, until I learn black oil is normal and what the numbers on the bottle really mean.
pitches.hook: The dipstick slides out and a black drop falls on the white rag; the neighbour's voice off-frame: 'ბინძურო.' FreezeTag on a greyscale dipstick photo, claim on frame 0, sound asmr-slide

pitches.logline: I brag in the chat that my diesel's oil went up by itself, a made-up friend calls me a sly jackal, and the truth is worse than his joke: fuel may be mixing into the oil.
pitches.hook: A phone buzzes: the friend's reply lands under my proud dipstick photo, 'ტურა ხარ.' The photo frozen with the claim on frame 0, sound real-phone-buzz

pitches.logline: On a Bakuriani ski weekend a made-up uncle mocks my 5W-30 as 'oil for five winters' and pushes thicker 10W-30; the twist: W does mean winter, but the 5 is how well it flows cold, and the wrong grade costs fuel.
pitches.hook: The cold engine cranks on a frozen morning while the uncle calls from the porch, 'ჩერჩეტო'. The 5W-30 bottle frozen in the frame with the claim, sound real-diesel-crank

treatment.logline: On a Bakuriani ski weekend a made-up uncle mocks my 5W-30 as oil for five winters and pushes his thicker 10W-30; W does mean winter, but the 5 is how well the oil flows cold, and the wrong grade costs fuel.
treatment.hero: Me, a made-up young woman in a camel ski puffer with a high ponytail, and my diesel hatchback in a Bakuriani guesthouse yard
treatment.obstacle: The uncle's confident misreading of the label: 5W means five winters, and his thicker oil is better

hook.event: My cold diesel turns over on a frozen morning while the uncle calls me ჩერჩეტი over my oil, the word lifted big on frame 0

act1: The uncle calls me ჩერჩეტი while the cold engine turns over
It is about my oil: in the yard he points at me in profile
His thicker 10W-30 slides over to me and I slump; the hold, no answer
treatment.turn: White flash out of the hold: არაუშავს! slammed, then me in profile, chin up, the label over me

reveal.what: The camera dives through the W of 5W-30 into a frozen car tagged winter: W is winter, the uncle got that much right

treatment.payoff: The same me, now sure: the 5W-30 the maker asks for stays with me, the uncle's 10W-30 goes back to him, and I thank him
treatment.signature: The label 5W-30 alone on a white card, a hand bracket under the 5 marking it the winter digit, then circled
